stories.title: Supreme Court seeks response on anti-defection law reforms
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has sought responses from the Centre, the Election Commission, and the Law Commission regarding a plea for anti-defection reforms. The petition alleges that elected representatives misuse resignations to circumvent disqualification and influence government survival. The court has issued notices to the relevant ministries.

stories.title: Congress and Left clash over Gaza remarks
stories.summary: Rahul Gandhi's recent comments linking the October 7 Hamas attack to the deaths of Palestinians in Gaza have triggered a backlash from Left parties. The disagreement highlights ongoing ideological tensions between the Congress and the Left, despite their current electoral cooperation within the INDIA alliance.

stories.title: Supreme Court rejects PIL on electoral roll corrections
stories.summary: The Supreme Court dismissed a PIL seeking corrections to municipal electoral rolls in Uttar Pradesh, citing house number discrepancies. The bench stated that the right to seek such corrections is personal to individual voters and cannot be pursued collectively through a PIL. Individual voters must approach election authorities.

stories.title: ED summons AAP MLA and family in money laundering probe
stories.summary: The Enforcement Directorate has summoned AAP MLA Amandeep Kaur Arora and her family members in a money laundering investigation. The agency alleges that the legislator and her husband facilitated the siphoning of government compensation funds intended for local residents in the Moga district.

stories.title: Congress and Samajwadi Party report cordial seat-sharing talks
stories.summary: Congress and Samajwadi Party leaders described their initial seat-sharing discussions for the upcoming Uttar Pradesh assembly elections as cordial. The parties have formed four-member panels to manage the process, with a final announcement expected within three days.

stories.title: Akhilesh Yadav to make final call on SP-Congress seat-sharing
stories.summary: Samajwadi Party leader Fakhrul Hasan Chand confirmed that a four-member committee will discuss constituency preferences and potential candidates with the Congress. While the committee will assess electoral prospects, the final decision regarding the seat-sharing arrangement for the 2027 Uttar Pradesh assembly elections rests with SP chief Akhilesh Yadav.

stories.title: Uttar Pradesh transfers 144 police officers
stories.summary: The Uttar Pradesh government has transferred 144 police officers, including deputy superintendents and assistant commissioners, ahead of the 2027 assembly elections. The reshuffle includes significant changes within the Lucknow police commissionerate, affecting district units, the Provincial Armed Constabulary, and various training centres.

stories.title: Prashant Kishor claims BJP is absorbing JD(U) in Bihar
stories.summary: Jan Suraaj founder Prashant Kishor accused the BJP of systematically wiping out the JD(U) in Bihar. Kishor claimed the BJP is gradually swallowing its ruling alliance partner and its leadership, noting that the political decline of the party is visible to anyone with an understanding of state politics.

stories.title: Congress and Samajwadi Party form seat-sharing panels
stories.summary: The Samajwadi Party and Congress have each established four-member panels to negotiate seat-sharing for the upcoming Uttar Pradesh assembly elections. The committees are tasked with coordinating electoral strategy and constituency allocations in the run-up to the polls.

stories.title: Prashant Kishor alleges BJP is finishing off JD(U)
stories.summary: Jan Suraaj founder Prashant Kishor stated that the JD(U) is being systematically dismantled by the BJP in Bihar. Responding to comments about the BJP discarding political allies, Kishor claimed that the process of the BJP swallowing its partner is already evident to observers of state politics.

stories.title: Congress leaders distance party from remarks on cricketer Siraj
stories.summary: Congress leaders have rejected comments made by Imran Masood regarding the exclusion of cricketer Mohammed Siraj from a test match. The party leadership emphasized that politics and sports should remain separate, following the backlash generated by Masood's remarks.

stories.title: BJP criticizes Rahul Gandhi over foreign policy remarks
stories.summary: The BJP responded to Rahul Gandhi's criticism of the Modi government's foreign policy by referencing historical textbooks. Gandhi had targeted the Prime Minister for his absence from a trilateral meeting between the leaders of China, Russia, and the United States at the APEC Summit.

stories.title: Namma Metro reports ridership and revenue growth
stories.summary: Bengaluru Namma Metro recorded 310.49 million passenger journeys during 2025 to 26, a 12.42 percent increase in average daily ridership. Fare revenue rose 49 percent to 1,125 crore rupees, bolstered by the adoption of various digital ticketing options and the introduction of the National Common Mobility Card.

stories.title: Streetlights removed after BJP candidate loses election
stories.summary: Following a BJP candidate's loss in the Panchayat Samiti elections, approximately 50 streetlights were removed from a Rajasthan village. An assistant engineer stated the lights were installed without authorization and their removal followed departmental policy. The village residents reported the removal occurred hours after the election results.

stories.title: Two killed in motorcycle crash in Kochi
stories.summary: Two youths died after their motorcycle crashed into a footpath near Changampuzha Park in Kochi early Monday. Police reported the vehicle struck a sign pole near Metro Pillar 457 while allegedly overspeeding. The identities of the riders were confirmed, though the operator remains unidentified.

stories.title: Telangana conducts polio immunization drive
stories.summary: Telangana administered polio drops to 17.21 lakh children across five districts during a recent immunization drive. The initiative achieved 95.6 percent of its target, with vaccines provided at designated booths and transit points, including airports and bus stations, to children aged below five years.

stories.title: Actor and former MP Innocent dies at 75
stories.summary: Innocent, a veteran actor and former MP, has died at age 75. A cancer survivor, he had been hospitalized for respiratory ailments and Covid-related complications. He appeared in approximately 500 Malayalam films and served as the president of the Association of Malayalam Movie Artists.

stories.title: IIT Bombay replaces ceiling fans with wall-mounted units
stories.summary: IIT Bombay has replaced ceiling fans in student rooms with wall-mounted models following a student suicide. The institution implemented the change as part of its response to the incident, focusing on infrastructure adjustments within the campus residential facilities.

stories.title: Two killed as bus carrying pilgrims overturns in Jharkhand
stories.summary: Two people from Gujarat died and over 12 were injured after a bus carrying 50 pilgrims overturned near Madhuban on Monday. The vehicle was returning from the Parasnath pilgrimage site when it struck a tree and fell into a roadside ditch. The passengers were part of a larger convoy.

stories.title: Eight killed in minivan crash in Tamil Nadu
stories.summary: Eight people died and two were injured on Sunday after a minivan rammed into a tree in Tiruchirappalli. Preliminary investigations suggest the driver lost control due to overspeeding. The vehicle was carrying 10 passengers who were returning to Thirukattupalli at the time of the incident.

stories.title: Sonipat wedding cancelled after Delhi cop’s ₹13 lakh car demand, bride’s family seeks refund of expenses
stories.summary: Leena Dhankhar is Senior Editor and Bureau Chief, Gurugram, at Hindustan Times, where she has spent over 17 years chronicling the transformation of one of India's fastest-growing urban regions. From starting her career as a crime reporter to leading the Gurugram bureau, her journalism has been defined by investigative reporting,

stories.title: Three killed as tractor-trolley carrying pilgrims overturns in Madhya Pradesh
stories.summary: Three people died and 33 were injured after a tractor-trolley carrying 36 villagers overturned on National Highway-44 in Sagar district on Sunday. The victims were returning from a pilgrimage at Barman. Local authorities confirmed the deceased were residents of Garhaula Gosai village.

stories.title: Seven killed in Gujarat highway collision
stories.summary: Seven people, including two Army personnel, their wives, and three children, died in a head-on collision between a car and a truck in Kutch on Saturday night. The victims were travelling from Khavda when their vehicle was split in two by the impact.

stories.title: Over 100 children hospitalised after eating noodles at village fair
stories.summary: More than 100 children and 12 adults were hospitalised with suspected food poisoning after eating noodles at a village fair in Balaghat on Saturday. Officials state that all patients are currently stable. The district collector has directed medical staff to provide appropriate care.

stories.title: Karnataka CM promises support for Toyota expansion
stories.summary: Karnataka Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar met with Toyota leadership in Japan to discuss scaling the company's vehicle production capacity to one million units. The state government has pledged full support and facilitation for the expansion of Toyota's manufacturing operations within Karnataka.

stories.title: Karnataka CM eyes 1 million vehicle capacity for Toyota
stories.summary: Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar has invited Toyota Motor Corporation to expand its manufacturing operations in Karnataka. During a meeting at the company's Motomachi plant, the Chief Minister assured the automaker of government support as it targets a production capacity of one million vehicles.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu reports ₹1.14 lakh crore in new investments
stories.summary: Tamil Nadu has secured over ₹1 lakh crore in investments since the current government took office in May, according to officials. The state expects these projects to create 1.32 lakh jobs. A second investors’ conclave is scheduled to take place in Chennai on November 25.

stories.title: AIPC proposes professional support network for MSMEs
stories.summary: The All India Professionals’ Congress has proposed a support network to assist MSMEs with legal, financial, and technical expertise. National chairman Madhu Goud Yaskhi suggested that professionals volunteer to help small enterprises navigate regulatory compliance and address the ₹7 lakh crore currently held up in delayed payments.

stories.title: Indo-Japan Chamber of Commerce to lead business delegation
stories.summary: The Indo-Japan Chamber of Commerce and Industry is leading a 16-member business delegation to Japan from November 30 to December 4. The trip follows a networking meeting with representatives from Osaka and aims to strengthen bilateral trade, investment, and industrial collaboration between the two nations.

stories.title: Atomic Energy Department hosts vendor-buyer meet
stories.summary: The Department of Atomic Energy held a vendor-buyer meet for 53 firms in Pallavaram to discuss registration on the Government e-Marketplace portal. The event focused on familiarising vendors with procurement processes and recent updates to the platform, with 45 of the participating companies identified as MSMEs.

stories.title: India’s mobile gaming market faces monetisation gap
stories.summary: India recorded 8.45 billion mobile-game downloads in fiscal year 2025, the highest globally, yet generated just over $400 million in in-app purchase revenue. Industry executives attribute the disparity to limited ownership of original intellectual property and a persistent struggle to convert high download volumes into paying customers.

stories.title: SG Mart shares rise amid APL Apollo fundraising plans
stories.summary: Shares of SG Mart rose 14 percent following news of fundraising plans. The company is led by the same promoter family as APL Apollo Tubes, which recently saw Tata Steel announce a 26.38 percent stake acquisition. SG Mart has rallied 200 percent since the start of 2026.

stories.title: Delhi Minister claims 60 percent of Yamuna is clean
stories.summary: Delhi Environment Minister Manjinder Singh Sirsa stated on Monday that 60 percent of the Yamuna river is now clean enough for the water to be potable. He credited the Chief Minister and the Union government for the progress, promising the entire river will be cleaned by 2030.

stories.title: Earthmover at Amarnath Yatra stopover draws criticism
stories.summary: A video showing an earthmover operating at the high-altitude Sheshnag lake has prompted calls for the protection of the ecologically fragile region. The site serves as a stopover for pilgrims on the Amarnath Yatra. Political parties and locals have demanded an immediate halt to the use of machinery.

stories.title: Coastal erosion impacts Andhra Pradesh
stories.summary: Professor B.S.R. Reddy reports that stretches of the Andhra Pradesh coastline have lost their beaches entirely, with waves now striking roads directly. Once characterised by high dunes and wide sandy expanses, the area has undergone significant physical changes since the 1960s.

stories.title: Pollution levels remain high across Indian cities
stories.summary: Air quality in many Indian cities contains particulate matter at levels eight times higher than recommended thresholds. Following the festival of lights, the National Capital Region saw air quality index readings reach 400. Experts are calling for a sustained movement to address the recurring national air crisis.

stories.title: NGT takes suo motu cognisance of garbage dumping in Faridabad’s Aravallis
Delhi’s AQI remains 'poor', minimum temperature recorded at 11.1°C
CPCB’s AQI method understates severity of Delhi’s worst pollution days
Punjab, Haryana fall short on farm fire management
stories.summary: The Commission for Air Quality Management reports that Punjab and Haryana have shown unsatisfactory performance in managing stubble burning. Haryana achieved 35 percent of its target, while Punjab reached 53 percent. Delhi also missed several targets set under the 2026 action plans for tackling air pollution.

stories.title: PM Modi holds bilateral talks with Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah met at Hyderabad House to discuss economic cooperation, trade, and infrastructure development. The two leaders are expected to exchange memorandums of understanding covering areas including education, health, agriculture, and disaster management during the state visit.

stories.title: PM Modi meets Nepal PM Balendra Shah, both exchange gifts in Delhi
PM Modi praises Balen Shah’s ‘far-sighted vision’, announces package worth ₹15,000 crore
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced a development package worth 15,000 crore rupees for Nepal during Prime Minister Balendra Shah's state visit. The leaders virtually flagged off the Saryu-Kamala Express, which connects Ayodhya to Janakpur. India also plans to increase scholarships for Nepali students in law and technology.

stories.title: Appreciate India’s plan for Ukraine: Dutch foreign minister
stories.summary: External affairs minister S Jaishankar met Dutch counterpart Tom Berendsen to review bilateral cooperation in technology, energy, and agriculture. The Dutch side expressed support for India's proposal for a ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine. The two nations continue to build on a strategic partnership unveiled in May.

stories.title: India, Iran hold bilateral meet, no formal talks with Pakistan on sidelines of SCO forum
stories.summary: India and Iran held bilateral talks on the sidelines of the SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum to discuss cultural cooperation. Union Culture Secretary Vivek Aggarwal confirmed that no formal bilateral talks took place between India and Pakistan during the three-day event hosted in New Delhi.

stories.title: ‘Haven’t invited me to discuss Indus waters’: Pak minister Musadik Malik evades questions
'India's diversity is amazing': Putin praises Indian civilisation
Balen Shah India visit highlights
stories.summary: Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah is on a two-day state visit to India at the invitation of Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The visit includes meetings with President Droupadi Murmu and external affairs minister S Jaishankar to discuss the special friendship between the two nations.

stories.title: $2 billion economic package, meeting with Modi on agenda as Nepal PM Balen Shah visits India today
Nepal PM Balen Shah India Visit LIVE Updates
stories.summary: Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah arrived in New Delhi on Sunday for a two-day state visit. The schedule includes bilateral talks with Prime Minister Narendra Modi at Hyderabad House to review ties between the two countries.

stories.title: India, Nepal get new rail link connecting Ayodhya and Janakpur Dham
stories.summary: A new rail link now connects Ayodhya in Uttar Pradesh to Janakpur Dham in Nepal. The Saryu Kamala Express will operate once a week, covering 604 km in approximately 19 hours. The service aims to facilitate travel between the two religious destinations.

stories.title: PM Modi, Nepal PM hold bilateral talks, connectivity, trade, energy on agenda
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah met in New Delhi to review bilateral relations. Discussions focused on expanding cooperation in trade, investment, infrastructure, energy, and connectivity. The visit follows an invitation from the Indian government to strengthen ties across key sectors.

stories.title: AI is moving from something we use, to acting on our behalf: Omnissa’s Amit Singh
stories.summary: Omnissa CEO Amit Singh says AI is shifting from a tool to an agent acting on behalf of users. The company recently expanded its Omnissa Sovereign Solution to six new markets, aiming to help enterprises govern their AI stacks and maintain control over agentic endpoints.

stories.title: Meta’s India content restrictions jump 131-fold to 5.44 million in first half of 2026
Shashi Tharoor tries GTA 6 for the first time
stories.summary: Congress leader Shashi Tharoor has tested the video game GTA 6. His initial assessment of the experience involved a play on the title, questioning the presence of an automobile in the act of grand theft. The game remains available for those who prefer their crime virtual.

stories.title: Shashi Tharoor plays GTA 6, calls demonetisation grand theft without auto
stories.summary: Congress leader Shashi Tharoor has tried his hand at GTA 6. He compared the experience to the 2016 demonetisation policy, describing the latter as grand theft without the auto. The game continues to serve as a metaphor for fiscal policy.

stories.title: NHAI deploys dashcams to monitor highway defects
stories.summary: The National Highways Authority of India is using patrol vehicles with dashcams to identify 40 types of road defects. The system records conditions and locations for maintenance contractors. The authority aims to keep contractors on their toes, though the roads themselves remain under observation.

stories.title: Sensex surges 20 percent in dollar terms
stories.summary: The Sensex has risen 20 percent in dollar terms, a threshold often cited as the start of a bull market. Analysts attribute the growth to foreign investment moving away from AI-focused trades. Market conventions are currently being tested by the inflow of capital.

stories.title: L&T secures deal to deploy NVIDIA B300 GPUs
stories.summary: Vyoma.AI, through its subsidiary LTN Compute, has secured a multi-year deal to deploy NVIDIA B300 GPUs in Chennai. The data center is designed to support 250 MW as part of a gigawatt-scale infrastructure hub. The facility aims to power commercial-scale AI model training.

stories.title: IT stocks rise as AI investment concerns grow
stories.summary: Shares of TCS, Infosys, and Wipro rose up to 3 percent as investors questioned whether massive spending on AI data centers will generate returns. The Nasdaq recently logged its worst week since 2020. The market is currently weighing the cost of compute against the promise of intelligence.

stories.title: No COP31 cover decision leaves India’s equity, finance demands unresolved

Gandhiok has over a decade of experience in journalism and is based in Delhi. He has reported extensively on Delhi and the National Capital Region

stories.summary: Jasjeev Gandhiok is an Assistant Editor with Hindustan Times, where he covers environment, climate change, the clean energy transition and wildlife at the National Bureau. Gandhiok has over a decade of experience in journalism and is based in Delhi. He has reported extensively on Delhi and the National Capital Region

stories.title: El Nino may trigger floods and landslides in Hindu Kush Himalaya
stories.summary: A report indicates that a strong El Nino event could trigger floods, landslides, and avalanches in the Hindu Kush Himalaya region during the winter. The forecast highlights potential risks for the area as weather patterns shift. The mountains are expected to remain volatile.

stories.title: Medicos warn against fairness creams after kidney disorder case
stories.summary: A 17-year-old girl in Malappuram was diagnosed with membranous nephropathy after using a fairness cream. Hospital tests reportedly found 1.25 percent mercury in the product. Doctors are now warning that the pursuit of cosmetic changes can involve significant risks to vital organs.

stories.title: Bisleri maintains water safety after FSSAI prosecution
stories.summary: Bisleri International says its water is safe for consumption, disputing FSSAI findings of unsafe samples. The company stated it has received no notice regarding a 2025 sample that allegedly contained high bromate levels. It operates 143 plants and maintains that one batch does not define the brand.

stories.title: Dermatologists issue alert against instant-action fairness creams
stories.summary: The Indian Association of Dermatologists, Venereologists, and Leprologists has warned against fairness creams promising instant results. The alert follows a case where a teenager developed a kidney ailment from a mercury-laced product. Specialists note that manufacturers frequently omit ingredient lists from their packaging.

stories.title: India reaches one crore HPV vaccine milestone
stories.summary: India has administered over one crore doses of the HPV vaccine since February 2026. Prime Minister Narendra Modi described the milestone as a significant step in preventive healthcare for adolescent girls. The campaign aims to protect against cervical cancer through nationwide coverage.

stories.title: Bisleri says packaged drinking water ‘safe’ after FSSAI orders prosecution over ‘unsafe’ samples
stories.summary: Follow the latest breaking news, major developments and agenda-setting stories from India and around the world with the newsdesk at Hindustan Times. Operating round the clock, the desk brings together experienced editors, reporters and correspondents to deliver fast, accurate and contextual reporting across subjects that influence public policy, governance, business,

stories.title: India to expand water testing after Bisleri sample flagged
stories.summary: India's food safety regulator found a sample of Bisleri water unsafe, prompting plans to test products from all bottled water brands. The regulator has sanctioned prosecution against the company. The government is now broadening its oversight of the packaged drinking water industry.

stories.title: FSSAI sanctions prosecution against Bisleri
stories.summary: The FSSAI has sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri International after a regulatory sample of its packaged drinking water was declared unsafe. The regulator announced the action via social media. The company maintains that its water remains safe for consumption.

stories.title: "Water Safe For Consumption": Bisleri After Regulator Flags Carcinogens
stories.summary: To date, Bisleri has received no notice, the company said in a statement

stories.title: Bisleri under scanner after carcinogens found in water
stories.summary: Bisleri is under regulatory scrutiny following reports that a water sample contained bromate and polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons. Both substances are classified as carcinogens. The company maintains that its products are safe and that it has not yet received formal notice of the findings.

stories.title: Antibiotic resistance and the habit of incomplete courses
stories.summary: Many Indian households treat lingering fevers by using leftover antibiotics from previous illnesses. While this feels like a sensible saving, it allows the hardiest bacteria to survive and multiply. Across millions of households and farms, this is how a medicine eventually stops working for everyone.

stories.title: Nationwide water checks follow Bisleri safety controversy
stories.summary: Authorities will conduct nationwide checks of packaged drinking water brands following safety findings against Bisleri. The regulator initially declared a sample unsafe and sanctioned prosecution, but subsequent testing found the company compliant with food safety regulations. The regulator has not clarified the discrepancy between the two tests.

stories.title: FSSAI sanctions prosecution of Bisleri and four other firms
stories.summary: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India has sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri International for unsafe drinking water. The regulator found a sample non-compliant with prescribed bromate limits, a finding supported by the Referral Food Laboratory. The company faces legal action while two other firms face license suspensions.

stories.title: DRDO scientist P.C. Jain receives Murli Manohar Joshi Award
stories.summary: Defence Research and Development Organisation scientist Prakash Chand Jain received the Dr. Murli Manohar Joshi Award for his contributions to missile system structural design. The award, instituted by the Federation for World Academics, recognises his work at the Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Missile Complex in Hyderabad.

stories.title: Andaman islands to receive undersea cable network
stories.summary: The Centre is considering a project to connect eight islands in the Andaman and Nicobar chain through an undersea cable network. The proposal, discussed by Union Telecommunications Secretary Amit Agrawal and Lieutenant Governor Dinesh Sharma, also includes expanding 4G mobile services to 87 currently unconnected villages.

stories.title: Kalpakkam nuclear centre completes emergency drill
stories.summary: The Department of Atomic Energy centre in Kalpakkam conducted an unannounced emergency preparedness drive on November 20. More than 7,000 personnel were evacuated during the simulation, which was completed in 90 minutes. The exercise is an annual feature intended to assess response capabilities at the nuclear facility.

stories.title: Meg Mason discusses her departure from Instagram
stories.summary: Author Meg Mason has permanently left Instagram. The writer of Sorrow and Bliss spoke about her relationship with social media and the process behind her new novel, Sophie, Standing There. She previously gained attention after Ann Patchett rescued her manuscript from a dustbin to read it.

stories.title: Nirmala Sitharaman publishes LinkedIn post on poverty
stories.summary: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman has published a blog post on LinkedIn regarding the concept of poverty. The post provides a deep dive into the subject from the perspective of the Finance Minister.

stories.title: Cockroach Janta Party launches youth club for political history
stories.summary: The Cockroach Janta Party has launched the Cockroach Club to engage young people with the ideas of Gandhi, Nehru and Ambedkar. The group, currently facing legal hurdles and police action, intends to use cultural activities and live performances to sustain its efforts among the youth.
